description: SCM Workbench main window — the UI the window actually runs is the worker's local server (http://127.0.0.1:8038), not the embedded assets: the shell loads its splash from the app's own origin, then hands the window to that server. Both origins need the same grants, or the worker-served UI sees an empty ACL and every invoke — the file dialogs first — is denied (local stays on by default; the remote context admits exactly the worker's loopback origin and nothing else).
